Durante la Operación Gumbinnen, el regimiento derribó 41 aviones Alemanes sin sufrir una sola baja. El 28 de Noviembre de 1944, por sus servicios en el cruce del río Neman en Lituania, el regimiento recibió el nombre de Normandie-Niemen.

Во время Гумбинненской операции полк сбил 41 немецкий самолёт, не понеся ни одной потери. 28 ноября 1944-го за заслуги в форсировании реки Неман в Литве полк получил название «Нормандия — Неман».

Piloci latali bojowo na myśliwcach Jak-1B, Jak-3 i Jak-9. <English>: Operation Road to Jerusalem was conducted in Iran from November 29th to December 7th, 1981. <English>: On December 5th, 1943, American and Australian forces launched an offensive on the Huon Peninsula in Papua New Guinea. The opposing Japanese forces were cut off from supplies and lost more than half their men in battle, as well as from disease and starvation. As they retreated, they buried a chest of documents in a stream bed that allowed the Allies to decipher secret Japanese communications.

En battant en retraite, elles ont enterré dans le lit d'un ruisseau un coffre contenant des documents qui ont permis aux Alliés de déchiffrer les communications secrètes des Japonais.

<English>: On December 31st, 1942, a convoy carrying equipment, fuel and supplies from Great Britain to the USSR collided with German ships in the Barents Sea. The attack by two German heavy cruisers was held off by British destroyers until two British light cruisers arrived, after which the Germans retreated. All cargo ships successfully reached Murmansk, and the head of the Kriegsmarine was removed from his post as a result of the defeat.

Tous les cargos atteignent Mourmansk et le chef de la Kriegsmarine est démis de ses fonctions à la suite de la défaite.

Tutte le navi mercantili raggiunsero con successo Murmansk e il capo della Kriegsmarine fu rimosso dal suo incarico a seguito della sconfitta.

<English>: On January 1st, 1945, German aircraft launched a massive attack on Allied airfields in the Netherlands, hoping to gain air superiority to support the Ardennes counteroffensive. They managed to destroy almost 500 Allied aircraft, but the losses among pilots were minimal, since the attack was sudden and the aircraft were on the ground. The Allies quickly replenished the lost equipment, but the Luftwaffe was unable to recover from the losses in personnel — this was their last strategic operation.
<French>: Le 1er janvier 1945, l’aviation allemande a lancé une attaque massive sur les aérodromes alliés aux Pays-Bas, espérant obtenir la supériorité aérienne pour soutenir la contre-offensive des Ardennes. Ils ont réussi à détruire près de 500 avions alliés, mais les pertes parmi les pilotes étaient minimes, car l’attaque était soudaine et les avions étaient au sol. Les Alliés ont rapidement remplacé les équipements perdus, mais la Luftwaffe n’a pas pu se remettre des pertes en personnel — ce fut leur dernière opération stratégique.
<Italian>: Il 1 gennaio 1945, gli aerei tedeschi lanciarono un massiccio attacco sugli aeroporti alleati nei Paesi Bassi, sperando di ottenere la superiorità aerea per aiutare la controffensiva delle Ardenne. Riuscirono a distruggere quasi 500 aerei alleati, ma le perdite tra i piloti furono minime, poiché l'attacco fu improvviso e gli aerei erano ancora a terra. Gli Alleati sostituirono rapidamente l'equipaggiamento perduto, ma la Luftwaffe non riuscì a riprendersi dalle perdite di personale: questa fu la loro ultima operazione strategica.

The Allies quickly replenished the lost equipment, but the Luftwaffe was unable to recover from the losses in personnel — this was their last strategic operation.

Consiguieron destruir casi 500 aviones Aliados, pero las pérdidas entre los pilotos fueron mínimas, ya que el ataque fue repentino y los aviones estaban en tierra. Los Aliados repusieron rápidamente el material perdido, pero la Luftwaffe no pudo recuperarse de las pérdidas de personal - ésta fue su última operación estratégica.
<Russian>: 1 января 1945 года немецкая авиация нанесла масштабный удар по аэродромам союзников в Нидерландах, рассчитывая завоевать превосходство в воздухе для поддержки контрнаступления в Арденнах. Ей удалось уничтожить почти 500 самолётов союзников, однако потери среди пилотов были минимальны, поскольку атака была внезапной, и самолёты стояли на земле. Союзники быстро восполнили утраченную технику, а вот люфтваффе от потерь личного состава оправиться не смогло — это была его последняя стратегическая операция.

<English>: The largest tank battle of the Iran-Iraq War took place from January 5th to 9th, 1981. The Iraqis knew that the Iranians were coming and prepared well, burying their tanks up to the turrets. They often practiced this tactic because they were not skilled enough to maneuver in combat, but in this case the swampy terrain played into their hands. The Iranians were ambushed, attacked from the front and flanks — they tried unsuccessfully to break through, then began to maneuver and got stuck in the mud. Operation Nasr, designed to liberate cities in southwestern Iran, completely failed, causing hundreds of vehicles to be lost.
<French>: La plus grande bataille de chars de la guerre Iran-Irak a eu lieu du 5 au 9 janvier 1981. Les Irakiens savaient que les Iraniens arrivaient et s’étaient bien préparés, enterrant leurs chars jusqu’à la tourelle. Ils pratiquaient souvent cette tactique car ils n’étaient pas assez habiles pour manœuvrer en combat, mais dans ce cas, le terrain marécageux jouait en leur faveur. Les Iraniens ont été pris en embuscade, attaqués de front et sur les flancs — ils ont tenté en vain de percer, puis ont commencé à manœuvrer et se sont retrouvés coincés dans la boue. L’opération Nasr, conçue pour libérer des villes dans le sud-ouest de l’Iran, a complètement échoué, entraînant la perte de centaines de véhicules.
<Italian>: La più grande battaglia tra carri armati della guerra Iran-Iraq ebbe luogo dal 5 al 9 gennaio 1981. Gli iracheni sapevano dell'arrivo dell'esercito iraniano e si prepararono bene, seppellendo i loro carri armati fino alle torrette. Praticavano spesso questa tattica perché non erano abbastanza abili nel manovrare in combattimento, ma in questo caso il terreno paludoso giocava a loro favore. Gli iraniani subirono un'imboscata venendo attaccati frontalmente e dai fianchi: tentarono senza successo di sfondare ma successivamente, manovrando nel fango, rimasero bloccati. L’operazione Nasr, pianificata per liberare le città dell’Iran sudoccidentale, fallì completamente, causando la perdita di centinaia di veicoli.

Иранцы попали в засаду, где их атаковали спереди и с флангов: они безуспешно попытались прорваться вперёд, затем начали маневрировать и увязли в грязи. <English>: On January 9th, 1945, the Battle of Luzon, the largest island of the Philippine Archipelago, began. It lasted until the very end of the war, although the Americans and Filipinos managed to recapture most of the island by March. At the beginning of the battle, 175,000 American soldiers landed on the island, although the landing operation was hampered by attacks from kamikaze pilots. In late January and early February, the island saw the largest tank battle in the Pacific theater.

<English>: This little-known operation, named after a type of grouse, took place from 13th to 27th January, 1945, on the border between the Netherlands and Germany. Having won the Ardennes, the Allies began to advance towards Germany, and in the “Roermond Triangle” between the Ruhr, Wurm and Maas rivers, British forces encountered three lines of German defense. However, the Germans were outnumbered and lacked air support, so their defeat was only a matter of time. Operation Blackcock had been fully achieved.

Après avoir remporté les Ardennes, les Alliés ont commencé à avancer vers l’Allemagne, et dans le « Triangle de Roermond » entre les rivières Ruhr, Wurm et Maas, les forces britanniques ont rencontré trois lignes de défense allemandes. Cependant, les Allemands étaient en infériorité numérique et manquaient de soutien aérien, donc leur défaite n’était qu’une question de temps. L’opération Blackcock a été pleinement réalisée.

Tuttavia, i tedeschi erano in inferiorità numerica e privi di supporto aereo, quindi la loro sconfitta era solo questione di tempo. L'operazione Blackcock era stata pienamente portata a termine.

<English>: On January 18th, 1943, the Red Army broke the blockade of Leningrad, which had been going on since September 1941, as part of Operation Iskra. Although the corridor controlled by the USSR was initially only 8-11 km wide, a highway and a railway were built in the shortest possible time to provide the city with everything it needed and to evacuate people. The Red Army was unable to continue its success, as it was only a year later that the enemy was completely driven away from Leningrad.

Bien que le corridor contrôlé par l’URSS ne mesurait initialement que 8-11 km de large, une route et une voie ferrée ont été construites dans les plus brefs délais pour approvisionner la ville et évacuer les habitants. L’Armée rouge n’a pas pu poursuivre son succès, car il a fallu attendre un an pour que l’ennemi soit complètement chassé de Leningrad.

L’Armata Rossa non riuscì a continuare il suo successo, poiché solo un anno dopo il nemico fu completamente scacciato da Leningrado.

<English>: In December 1943, Allied forces in Italy were stopped by the Gustav Line. In order to bypass the Axis fortifications from the flanks, the Allies carried out an amphibious operation, landing on January 22nd, 1944, at Anzio. American General John Lucas, who commanded the operation, did not believe in its success and, instead of using the element of surprise to attack the Germans from behind, began to fortify himself in the Anzio and Nettuno area. Field Marshal Kesselring transferred all available troops to this area, flooded the Pontine Marshes and pinned the Allies down with continuous artillery fire. A month later, General Lucas was removed from command, and the Battle of Anzio ultimately lasted until June.
<French>: En décembre 1943, les forces alliées en Italie ont été stoppées par la ligne Gustav. Afin de contourner les fortifications de l’Axe par les flancs, les Alliés ont mené une opération amphibie, débarquant le 22 janvier 1944 à Anzio. Le général américain John Lucas, qui commandait l’opération, ne croyait pas en son succès et, au lieu d’utiliser l’effet de surprise pour attaquer les Allemands par derrière, a commencé à se fortifier dans la région d’Anzio et Nettuno. Le maréchal Kesselring a transféré toutes les troupes disponibles dans cette zone, inondé les marais Pontins et immobilisé les Alliés avec des tirs d’artillerie continus. Un mois plus tard, le général Lucas a été relevé de son commandement, et la bataille d’Anzio a finalement duré jusqu’en juin.
<Italian>: Nel dicembre 1943 le forze alleate in Italia furono fermate dalla Linea Gustav. Per aggirare dai fianchi le fortificazioni dell'Asse, gli Alleati effettuarono un'operazione anfibia, sbarcando il 22 gennaio 1944 ad Anzio. Il generale americano John Lucas, che comandava l'operazione, non credette al successo e, invece di sfruttare l'elemento sorpresa per attaccare i tedeschi alle spalle, iniziò a fortificarsi nella zona tra Anzio e Nettuno. Il feldmaresciallo Kesselring trasferì tutte le truppe disponibili in quest'area, allagò le paludi pontine e immobilizzò gli alleati con un continuo fuoco di artiglieria. Un mese dopo, il generale Lucas fu rimosso dal comando e la battaglia di Anzio durò fino a giugno.
<German>: In December 1943, Allied forces in Italy were stopped by the Gustav Line. In order to bypass the Axis fortifications from the flanks, the Allies carried out an amphibious operation, landing on January 22nd, 1944, at Anzio. American General John Lucas, who commanded the operation, did not believe in its success and, instead of using the element of surprise to attack the Germans from behind, began to fortify himself in the Anzio and Nettuno area. Field Marshal Kesselring transferred all available troops to this area, flooded the Pontine Marshes and pinned the Allies down with continuous artillery fire. A month later, General Lucas was removed from command, and the Battle of Anzio ultimately lasted until June.
<Spanish>: En Diciembre de 1943, las fuerzas Aliadas en Italia fueron detenidas por la Línea Gustav. Para sortear las fortificaciones del Eje por los flancos, los Aliados llevaron a cabo una operación anfibia, desembarcando el 22 de Enero de 1944 en Anzio. El general Estadounidense John Lucas, que comandaba la operación, no creyó en su éxito y, en lugar de utilizar el factor sorpresa para atacar a los Alemanes por la retaguardia, comenzó a fortificarse en la zona de Anzio y Nettuno. El Mariscal de Campo Kesselring transfirió todas las tropas disponibles a esta zona, inundó las Marismas Pontinas y inmovilizó a los Aliados con un fuego de artillería continuo. Un mes después, el General Lucas fue destituido del mando, y la Batalla de Anzio duró finalmente hasta Junio.
<Russian>: В декабре 1943 года войска союзников в Италии были остановлены линией Густава. С целью обойти укрепления «Оси» с тыла союзники провели десантную операцию, высадившись 22 января 1944-го в Анцио. Командовавший операцией американский генерал Джон Лукас не верил в её успех и вместо того, чтобы воспользоваться элементом неожиданности для атаки на немецкий тыл, начал укрепляться в районе Анцио и Неттуно. Фельдмаршал Кессельринг перебросил на этот участок все свободные войска, затопил Понтинские болота и зажал союзников непрерывным артиллерийским огнём. Через месяц генерал Лукас был смещён с командования, а сражение под Анцио в итоге продолжалось аж до июня.
<Polish>: W grudniu 1943 roku siły alianckie we Włoszech zostały zatrzymane przez Linię Gustawa. Dowodzący nią amerykański generał John Lucas nie wierzył w jej sukces i zamiast wykorzystać element zaskoczenia do ataku na Niemców od tyłu, zaczął umacniać pozycje w rejonie Anzio i Nettuno. Feldmarszałek Kesselring przerzucił wszystkie dostępne wojska w ten rejon, zalał Bagna Pontyjskie i przygwoździł aliantów ciągłym ogniem artyleryjskim. Miesiąc później generał Lucas został usunięty ze stanowiska dowódcy, a bitwa pod Anzio ostatecznie trwała do czerwca – aż do zwycięstwa pod Monte Cassino.

<English>: On January 26th, 1945, the 4th Army of the Wehrmacht made a final attempt to break out of the encirclement near Heiligenbeil in East Prussia (now Mamonovo in the Kaliningrad region). The attempt ended in failure, as on January 30th, the ring of Soviet troops closed, and the Germans could only hold their positions and evacuate civilians across the Baltic Sea (the high command forbade the evacuation of the military). On March 29th, the pocket was liquidated.

La tentative a échoué, car le 30 janvier, l’anneau des troupes soviétiques s’est refermé, et les Allemands ne pouvaient que tenir leurs positions et évacuer les civils par la mer Baltique (le haut commandement interdisait l’évacuation des militaires). Le 29 mars, la poche a été liquidée.

Il 29 marzo la tasca venne liquidata.

Попытка обернулась провалом: 30 января кольцо советских войск сомкнулось, и немцам оставалось лишь удерживать свои позиции и эвакуировать мирных жителей через Балтийское море (эвакуировать военных запретило верховное командование). 29 марта котёл был ликвидирован.

<English>: Throughout the second half of January 1991, the international coalition effectively attacked Iraq from the air. Saddam Hussein wanted to engage his opponents in ground battles, where the Iraqi army had more experience due to the recently concluded Iran-Iraq War. On January 29th, 100 Iraqi tanks crossed the border between Kuwait and Saudi Arabia to attack the forces of the international coalition and take the city of Ras al-Khafji. The city’s population had been evacuated in advance. Throughout January 30th, the Iraqis managed to defend the city, but on February 1st they were forced to retreat. This battle demonstrated the importance of air support in modern warfare.

Le 29 janvier, 100 chars irakiens ont franchi la frontière entre le Koweït et l’Arabie Saoudite pour attaquer les forces de la coalition internationale et prendre la ville de Ras al-Khafji. <English>: In 1942, the Japanese army was able to occupy almost all of Burma, often bypassing British troops along routes that were considered impassable. The same thing happened to the 7th Division of the Indian Army on February 5th, 1944. Surrounded by Japanese troops, they decided not to retreat but instead fortify their administrative area. For two and a half weeks, the defenders of the “Admin Box” managed to hold off the enemy advance, largely thanks to tanks that the Japanese had no means to counter. Both sides suffered heavy losses, but due to a shortage of food and ammunition, Japanese forces were forced to retreat.

Encerclés par les troupes japonaises, ils ont décidé de ne pas battre en retraite mais de fortifier leur zone administrative. Pendant deux semaines et demie, les défenseurs de l'«Admin Box» ont réussi à repousser l'avancée ennemie, en grande partie grâce aux chars que les Japonais n'avaient aucun moyen de contrer. Les deux camps ont subi de lourdes pertes, mais en raison d'une pénurie de nourriture et de munitions, les forces japonaises ont été contraintes de battre en retraite.

<English>: On February 8th, 1971, South Vietnamese forces, backed by the United States, invaded Laos to cut off supplies and troops from North Vietnam along the Ho Chi Minh Trail through Laos. After suffering heavy losses, it withdrew from Laos in late March and the Ho Chi Minh Trail was reopened shortly after.

L'opération a été nommée d'après le village de Lam Son, lieu de naissance du héros national vietnamien Le Loi. L'armée sud-vietnamienne n'était pas préparée pour l'opération à grande échelle. Après avoir subi de lourdes pertes, elle s'est retirée du Laos fin mars et la piste Ho Chi Minh a été rouverte peu après.

Stalin ordered that Narva be taken at all costs by February 17th, 1944, but the offensive faltered and Germany continued to hold the city for another six months.

<English>: On March 5th, 1936, the British Supermarine Spitfire fighter took to the skies for the first time. It was mass-produced from 1938 to 1948, with over 20,000 units built. After the Battle of Britain, the Spitfire became the primary fighter of the Royal Air Force and was also flown by pilots from the USA, Canada, Free France, and the USSR under the Lend-Lease program.

<English>: By the end of April 1943, Axis forces were surrounded in Tunisia, with their fate sealed. Despite this, they did not surrender. Advancing British infantry were surprised by well-hidden German paratroopers, and their unprotected advancing tanks were attacked by incendiary bombs and disabled by mines. Operation Vulcan, the penultimate operation in the North African theatre, failed.

L'opération Vulcan, l'avant-dernière opération sur le théâtre nord-africain, échoue.

<English>: On April 29th, 1970, an operation by American and South Vietnamese forces began in Cambodia. Its goal was to support the Lon Nol government in the civil war against the Khmer Rouge and destroy North Vietnamese camps in the country. President Richard Nixon called the operation “the most successful military operation of the entire war”, but within five years both South Vietnam and the Lon Nol government in Cambodia had fallen.

Le président Richard Nixon a qualifié l'opération d'"opération militaire la plus réussie de toute la guerre", mais cinq ans plus tard, le Sud-Vietnam et le gouvernement de Lon Nol au Cambodge étaient tous deux tombés.

<English>:
Stepan Andreevich Neustroyev was a Soviet officer who commanded the 1st Rifle Battalion of the 756th Rifle Regiment in the 150th Rifle Division from 1943 in the Baltic, Vistula-Oder, East Pomeranian and Berlin. In Berlin, his regiment stormed the main entrance to the Reichstag — both Mikhail Yegorov and Meliton Kantaria, who raised the Soviet banner over the building, served under Neustroyev. Neustroyev was supposed to carry the Victory Banner at the parade on Red Square on June 24th, 1945, but was unable to do so due to a leg wound. Later, the Victory Banner was donated to a museum.

À Berlin, son régiment a pris d'assaut l'entrée principale du Reichstag — Mikhail Yegorov et Meliton Kantaria, qui ont hissé le drapeau soviétique sur le bâtiment, servaient sous les ordres de Neustroev. Neustroev devait porter la Bannière de la Victoire lors du défilé sur la Place Rouge le 24 juin 1945, mais il n'a pas pu le faire en raison d'une blessure à la jambe. Plus tard, la Bannière de la Victoire a été donnée à un musée.

Neustroyev was supposed to carry the Victory Banner at the parade on Red Square on June 24th, 1945, but was unable to do so due to a leg wound. Later, the Victory Banner was donated to a museum.

<English>: On May 27th, 1958, the McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II made its maiden flight. In the first few years following, it set many records for speed, flight altitude and rate of climb. It became the first aircraft capable of maintaining stable flight at an altitude of over 20 km. It debuted a pulse-Doppler radar and titanium was used in the aircraft’s production for the first time.
<French>: Le 27 mai 1958, le McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II a effectué son premier vol. Dans les premières années qui ont suivi, il a établi de nombreux records de vitesse, d'altitude de vol et de taux de montée. Il est devenu le premier avion capable de maintenir un vol stable à une altitude de plus de 20 km. Il a inauguré le radar à impulsions Doppler et le titane a été utilisé pour la première fois dans la production de l'avion.
<Italian>: Il 27 maggio 1958, il McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II effettuò il suo volo inaugurale. Nei primi anni successivi, stabilì numerosi record di velocità, altitudine di volo e velocità di salita. Fu il primo aereo capace di mantenere un volo stabile a un’altitudine superiore ai 20 km. Debuttò con un radar pulse-Doppler e, per la prima volta, fu utilizzato il titanio nella costruzione dell’aereo.

Se convirtió en el primer avión capaz de mantener un vuelo estable a más de 20 km de altitud. Estrenó un radar Doppler de impulsos y por primera vez se utilizó titanio en la producción del avión.

В первые же пару лет после этого он установил множество рекордов — по скорости, высоте полёта и скороподъёмности. Он стал первым самолётом, способным поддерживать стабильный полёт на высоте свыше 20 км. В нём дебютировал импульсно-доплеровский радар, а в производстве самолёта впервые использовался титан.

Stał się pierwszym samolotem zdolnym do utrzymania stabilnego lotu na wysokości ponad 20 km. Po raz pierwszy zastosowano w nim radar impulsowo-dopplerowski, a w konstrukcji po raz pierwszy wykorzystano tytan. Po zakończeniu produkcji w 1981 roku stał się amerykańskim naddźwiękowym samolotem bojowym zbudowanym w największej ilości w historii.

Japan lost four aircraft carriers and more than 3,000 sailors and airmen, including well-trained pilots, and ultimately the strategic initiative in the war.

<English>: On June 13th 1944, British troops advancing through Normandy as part of Operation Overlord unexpectedly encountered German forces near the town of Villers-Bocage. At the beginning of the battle, the Germans were able to take advantage of the surprise and superiority of their heavy Tiger tanks. Despite this, the British regrouped and successfully repelled the German attack, with their tanks operating without any infantry support.

Au début de la bataille, les Allemands ont pu tirer parti de l’effet de surprise et de la supériorité de leurs chars lourds Tiger. Malgré cela, les Britanniques se sont regroupés et ont repoussé avec succès l’attaque allemande, leurs chars opérant sans aucun soutien d’infanterie.

All'inizio della battaglia, i tedeschi riuscirono a sfruttare la sorpresa e la superiorità dei loro pesanti carri armati Tiger. Nonostante ciò, i britannici si riorganizzarono e respinsero con successo l'attacco tedesco, con i loro carri armati che operarono senza alcun supporto di fanteria.

<English>: On June 28th 1942, the execution of the “Blau” plan began. German leadership sent a significant part of the Wehrmacht forces to seize the Caucasian oil fields to provide the army with fuel. Stalin however was waiting for an attack on Moscow, so at first “Blau” had notable successes: in early July, German troops captured the western part of Voronezh and Rostov-on-Don. After that, Hitler ordered to split his forces, sending some of the Caucasus and some to Stalingrad. As a result, Germany suffered defeat on both fronts.

Le commandement allemand a envoyé une partie importante des forces de la Wehrmacht pour s’emparer des champs pétrolifères du Caucase afin de fournir du carburant à l’armée. Staline, cependant, attendait une attaque sur Moscou, si bien qu’au début, “Blau” a connu des succès notables : début juillet, les troupes allemandes ont capturé l’ouest de Voronej et Rostov-sur-le-Don. Par la suite, Hitler a ordonné de diviser ses forces, en envoyant une partie vers le Caucase et une autre vers Stalingrad. En conséquence, l’Allemagne a subi une défaite sur les deux fronts.

<English>: On July 17th, 1942, one of the greatest battles in history began. Le 10 août, l’île était enfin sous contrôle américain.

<French>: Boris Kovzan a participé à la Seconde Guerre mondiale dès l’invasion de l’URSS par l’Allemagne et a abattu son premier avion ennemi le 24 juin 1941. Kovzan était un véritable maître de l’éperonnage: Il a détruit quatre appareils ennemis de cette manière, tout en survivant à chaque fois. Il effectua son dernier éperonnage le 13 août 1942 près de Staraya Russa: Il affronta des forces ennemies supérieures et fut grièvement blessé à la tête, perdant son œil droit. Suite à la collision, Kovzan fut éjecté du cockpit de son avion à 6 000 m d’altitude et ne put ouvrir son parachute qu’à proximité du sol. Après 10 mois d’hospitalisation, il reprit du service et reçut en 1943 le titre de Héros de l’Union Soviétique.
<Italian>: Boris Kovzan partecipò alla Seconda Guerra Mondiale dopo l'invasione dell'URSS da parte della Germania e abbatté il suo primo aereo nemico il 24 giugno 1941. Kovzan era un vero maestro nello speronamento: distrusse quattro aerei nemici usando questa strategia e sopravvivendo. Kovzan eseguì il suo ultimo speronamento il 13 agosto 1942 nei pressi di Staraya Russa: incontrò forze nemiche superiori e riportò una grave ferita alla testa, perdendo l'occhio destro. A seguito della collisione, Kovzan fu sbalzato fuori dalla cabina di pilotaggio del suo aereo da un'altitudine di 6.000 metri e solo in prossimità del suolo riuscì ad aprire il paracadute. Dopo 10 mesi di ricovero in ospedale, tornò in servizio e nel 1943 ricevette il titolo di Eroe dell'Unione Sovietica.

<English>: After Britain rejected German peace offers, the Luftwaffe was ordered to gain air superiority over the island in preparation for an amphibious invasion. A major attack on RAF airfields was launched on Eagle Day, August 13th, 1940, followed five days later by another. This second attack was so large that of the entire Battle of Britain, the 18th of August was nicknamed the "Hardest Day". Germany failed to achieve its objectives and abandoned the invasion of Britain.
<French>: Après le refus britannique des offres de paix allemandes, la Luftwaffe reçoit l’ordre d’obtenir la supériorité aérienne sur l’île en vue d’une invasion amphibie. Une attaque majeure sur les aérodromes de la RAF est lancée le 13 août 1940 (“Eagle Day”), suivie cinq jours plus tard d’une autre attaque massive. Cette seconde attaque fut si importante que, dans toute la bataille d’Angleterre, le 18 août fut surnommé le “jour le plus difficile”. L’Allemagne échoue à atteindre ses objectifs et renonce à l’invasion.
<Italian>: Dopo che la Gran Bretagna respinse le offerte di pace tedesche, alla Luftwaffe fu ordinato di ottenere la superiorità aerea sull'isola in preparazione di un'invasione anfibia. Venne lanciato un massiccio attacco sugli aeroporti della RAF durante "il Giorno dell'Aquila", il 13 agosto 1940, seguito da un altro cinque giorni dopo. Questo secondo attacco del 18 agosto fu così imponente che, di tutta la Battaglia d'Inghilterra,fu soprannominato il "Giorno più difficile" (The Hardest Day). La Germania non riuscì a raggiungere i suoi obiettivi e abbandonò l'intento d'invasione della Gran Bretagna.

Масштабная атака на аэродромы Королевских ВВС была предпринята в «День орла», 13 августа 1940 года, а через пять дней последовала ещё одна — настолько масштабная, что из всей Битвы за Британию именно 18 августа получило прозвище «Самый трудный день». Máy bay của ông được gọi là Rosie the Rocketer. Trong Trận Arracoor, ông đã phá hủy một xe bọc thép chở quân và bốn xe tăng của Đức. Trong một cuộc phỏng vấn, sau này ông mô tả phương châm chiến đấu của mình là "tấn công, tấn công, rồi lại tấn công".

<English>: On September 7th, 1945, a Victory Parade took place in Berlin. Marshal Zhukov represented the USSR, General George Patton represented the USA, General Brian Robertson represented Great Britain, and General Marie-Pierre Koenig represented France. The Allies celebrated the defeat of the Nazi regime together. Shortly after the parade in Tiergarten, a memorial to fallen Soviet soldiers was unveiled.

Les Alliés ont célébré ensemble la défaite du régime nazi. Peu après le défilé au Tiergarten, un mémorial dédié aux soldats soviétiques tombés au combat a été inauguré.

<English>: On September 8th to 10th, 1965, one of the largest tank battles since the Second World War took place near the village of Asal Uttar in India. The Pakistani army planned to break through deep into Indian territory, but it was met with minefields, territories flooded by India, and a well-organized counterattack. Despite the numerical superiority of Pakistani tank forces, they suffered three times as many losses and were forced to retreat.
<French>: Du 8 au 10 septembre 1965, l’une des plus grandes batailles de chars depuis la Seconde Guerre mondiale s’est déroulée près du village d’Asal Uttar, en Inde. L’armée pakistanaise prévoyait de percer profondément en territoire indien, mais elle s’est heurtée à des champs de mines, à des zones inondées par l’Inde et à une contre-attaque bien organisée. Malgré la supériorité numérique des chars pakistanais, ils ont subi trois fois plus de pertes et ont dû battre en retraite.
<Italian>: Dall’8 al 10 settembre 1965, nei pressi del villaggio di Asal Uttar in India, ebbe luogo una delle più grandi battaglie di carri armati dalla Seconda Guerra Mondiale. L’esercito pakistano progettava di penetrare in profondità nel territorio indiano, ma trovò ad attenderlo campi minati, aree allagate dagli indiani e una controffensiva ben organizzata. Nonostante la superiorità numerica delle forze corazzate pakistane, queste subirono perdite triplicate rispetto agli indiani e furono costrette a ritirarsi.

Despite the numerical superiority of Pakistani tank forces, they suffered three times as many losses and were forced to retreat.

A pesar de la superioridad numérica de las fuerzas de tanques Paquistaníes, éstas sufrieron el triple de pérdidas y se vieron obligadas a retirarse.

Пакистанская армия планировала прорыв вглубь индийской территории, однако её ждали минные поля, затопленные долины и хорошо организованная контратака. Несмотря на численное превосходство танковых сил Пакистана, они понесли втрое большие потери и были вынуждены отступить.

L’ordre fut exécuté dans la précipitation, si bien que toutes les unités blindées de la Wehrmacht n’eurent pas le temps de se regrouper avant l’attaque, ce qui entraîna de lourdes pertes. La bataille fut perdue et, pour 50 chars alliés détruits, plus de 200 chars allemands furent perdus.

<English>: On September 25th, 1942, the decisive defensive operation in the North Caucasus began. Soviet troops managed to stop the advance of German and Romanian troops along the Kuban, preventing them from reaching Tuapse and the Black Sea. By pinning down enemy forces in this region, the USSR prevented Germany from advancing to the Baku oil fields.

Les troupes soviétiques parviennent à stopper l’avancée des troupes allemandes et roumaines le long du Kouban, les empêchant d’atteindre Touapsé et la mer Noire. En fixant les forces ennemies dans cette région, l’URSS a empêché l’Allemagne de progresser vers les champs pétrolifères de Bakou.

Bloccando le forze nemiche in questa regione, l’URSS impedì alla Germania di avanzare verso i giacimenti petroliferi di Baku.

<English>: One of Iran’s first major counteroffensives in the war with Iraq took place from September 27th to 29th, 1981. Despite the numerical superiority of Iraqi troops, Iran’s air superiority and smart tactical decisions allowed Iranian forces to liberate the city of Abadan, which was under siege.

Malgré la supériorité numérique des troupes irakiennes, la supériorité aérienne iranienne et des choix tactiques judicieux ont permis aux forces iraniennes de libérer la ville d’Abadan, alors assiégée.

<English>:
Leo Major is the only Canadian to receive the Distinguished Conduct Medal for service in multiple wars. He participated in the Normandy Landings and lost his left eye in the Battle of Caen, but insisted on remaining in the line of duty. During the Battle of the Scheldt, he single-handedly captured 93 German soldiers. Major received his first Distinguished Conduct Medal in 1945 for single-handedly liberating the Dutch city of Zwolle. His overnight actions forced German forces to retreat, prompting the Allies to cancel a planned artillery bombardment on the city. He received his second medal six years later for capturing strategic hills in the Korean War.

Lors de la bataille de l’Escaut, il a capturé seul 93 soldats allemands. Major a reçu sa première Distinguished Conduct Medal en 1945 pour avoir libéré seul la ville néerlandaise de Zwolle. Son action nocturne a forcé les forces allemandes à battre en retraite, ce qui a permis aux Alliés d’annuler un bombardement d’artillerie prévu sur la ville. Il a reçu sa seconde médaille six ans plus tard pour la prise de collines stratégiques pendant la guerre de Corée.

<English>: In early August 1944, as part of the first American landing on Guadalcanal, an airfield under construction was captured. It was named after Lofton Henderson, a U.S. Marine Corps commander killed in the Battle of Midway. From October 23rd-26th, the Japanese attempted to recapture the airfield with a surprise ground attack supported by air and naval forces. Several dozen Americans and between two and three thousand Japanese were killed in the battle. After this defeat, Japan made no further major offensive attempts on Guadalcanal.

Du 23 au 26 octobre, les Japonais tentent de reprendre l’aérodrome par une attaque surprise appuyée par l’aviation et la marine. Plusieurs dizaines d’Américains et entre deux et trois mille Japonais sont tués. Après cette défaite, le Japon ne tente plus de grande offensive à Guadalcanal.

Dal 23 al 26 ottobre, i giapponesi tentarono di riconquistare l’aeroporto con un attacco terrestre a sorpresa, supportato da forze aeree e navali. Nella battaglia morirono diverse decine di americani e tra i duemila e tremila giapponesi. Dopo questa sconfitta, il Giappone non tentò più alcuna grande offensiva su Guadalcanal.

<English>: On December 9th, 1940, Great Britain launched an operation against Italian forces in Egypt. Despite Italy’s colossal superiority in both manpower and equipment, it was completely defeated. Italy would lose over 133,000 soldiers along with hundreds of tanks and thousands of artillery pieces. Britain took control of western Egypt and Cyrenaica.

L’Italie perdit plus de 133 000 soldats, ainsi que des centaines de chars et des milliers de pièces d’artillerie. Le Royaume-Uni prit le contrôle de l’ouest de l’Égypte et de la Cyrénaïque.

<English>: From mid-December 1944 to the end of January 1945, Germany made its last attempt at a strategic counter-offensive on the Western Front. In the Ardennes in southeastern Belgium, the Wehrmacht clashed with British and US forces, and was defeated. The “Battle of the Bulge”, as it was called in the USA, became the bloodiest in the country’s history, with more than 100,000 American casualties.

<English>: After repelling the Wehrmacht’s offensive on Moscow in December 1941, the Red Army launched a counter-offensive. The freshly inspired command expected a quick victory over Germany as early as 1942. The offensive was conducted along the entire front by rifle divisions without any supporting actions to pin down or divert enemy forces. This approach predictably failed, with the operation halting after the onset of spring.
<French>: Après avoir repoussé l’offensive de la Wehrmacht sur Moscou en décembre 1941, l’Armée rouge lança une contre-offensive. Un commandement regonflé à bloc espérait une victoire rapide sur l’Allemagne dès 1942. L’offensive fut menée sur l’ensemble du front par des divisions d’infanterie, sans opérations de diversion ou de fixation de l’ennemi. Cette approche échoua comme on pouvait s’y attendre et l’opération fut stoppée avec l’arrivée du printemps.

Il comando, appena ispirato dalla vittoria, si aspettava una rapida sconfitta della Germania già nel 1942. L’offensiva fu condotta lungo l’intero fronte dalle divisioni di fanteria senza alcun supporto per impegnare o distrarre le forze nemiche. Questo approccio, prevedibilmente, fallì, e l’operazione si arrestò con l’arrivo della primavera.

Este enfoque fracasó previsiblemente, y la operación se detuvo tras el inicio de la primavera.

<English>: On December 31st 1942, a German naval group led by the heavy cruisers Admiral Hipper and Lützow attacked a British convoy in the Barents Sea as it ferried fuel and equipment to the USSR. Despite the superiority of the German forces, the British managed to repel the attack, losing just two escort ships. Admiral Hipper sustained serious heavy damage and retreated, and the convoy reached Murmansk without losing a single transport.

Malgré la supériorité des forces allemandes, les Britanniques parvinrent à repousser l’attaque en ne perdant que deux navires d’escorte. L’Admiral Hipper subit de lourds dégâts et dut se replier, et le convoi atteignit Mourmansk sans perdre un seul transport.

Nonostante la superiorità delle forze tedesche, i britannici riuscirono a respingere l’attacco, perdendo soltanto due navi di scorta. L’Admiral Hipper subì gravi danni e si ritirò, mentre il convoglio raggiunse Murmansk senza perdere alcun trasporto.

<English>: On the morning of January 1st, 1945, the Luftwaffe conducted its last major operation. It launched a massive strike with fighter-bombers on Allied airfields, hoping to gain air superiority. The operation was conducted in total secrecy, and their own anti-aircraft gunners shot down German planes more than once. The Allies quickly recovered from their losses, while the Luftwaffe lost too many pilots and could not recover by the end of the war.

Elle lança une frappe massive avec des chasseurs-bombardiers sur les aérodromes alliés, espérant gagner la supériorité aérienne. L'opération a été menée dans le secret total, et leurs propres canonniers antiaériens ont abattu des avions allemands plus d'une fois. Les Alliés se sont rapidement remis de leurs pertes, tandis que la Luftwaffe a perdu trop de pilotes et n'a pas pu s'en remettre avant la fin de la guerre.

L’operazione fu condotta nel massimo segreto tanto che più volte molti aerei tedeschi vennero abbattuti dalla propria contraerea. Gli Alleati si ripresero rapidamente dalle perdite, mentre la Luftwaffe perse troppi piloti e non riuscì a riprendersi entro la fine della guerra.

<English>: On January 9th, 1945, US troops, under continuous kamikaze attacks, initiated an operation on Luzon — the largest island of the Philippine Archipelago. 175,000 soldiers landed on the island and engaged the Japanese garrison. <English>: On January 18th, 1943, during Operation Iskra, the siege of Leningrad was broken. The city was reconnected with the rest of the country by a land route, replacing the ice crossing — the "Road of Life". As early as February 6th, trains began to run on the hastily built railway, and Leningrad began to receive supplies in much larger volumes.

Dès le 6 février, des trains ont commencé à circuler sur la voie ferrée construite à la hâte, et Leningrad a commencé à recevoir des approvisionnements en volumes beaucoup plus importants.

Già dal 6 febbraio iniziarono a circolare i treni sulla ferrovia costruita in fretta, e Leningrado cominciò a ricevere rifornimenti in quantità molto maggiori.

<English>: On January 22nd, the Allies conducted a daring amphibious operation on the coast of the Tyrrhenian Sea, landing behind the impregnable fortress of Monte Cassino at Anzio. They did not take advantage of the element of surprise. Instead of advancing into the enemy's rear, they began to dig in. As a result, the Germans easily surrounded the Allies at Anzio and shelled them until the summer, when the fall of Rome forced Germany to retreat.
<French>: Le 22 janvier, les Alliés ont mené une opération amphibie audacieuse sur la côte de la mer Tyrrhénienne, débarquant derrière la forteresse imprenable du Mont Cassin à Anzio. Ils n'ont pas profité de l'effet de surprise. Au lieu d'avancer sur les arrières de l'ennemi, ils ont commencé à s'enterrer. En conséquence, les Allemands ont facilement encerclé les Alliés à Anzio et les ont bombardés jusqu'à l'été, quand la chute de Rome a forcé l'Allemagne à battre en retraite.

Non sfruttarono l’elemento sorpresa. Invece di avanzare alle spalle del nemico, iniziarono a trincerarsi. <English>: From February 5th to the 23rd, British Empire forces held the line against the Japanese advance into Burma. Surrounded, they fortified themselves near the administrative building that gave the battle its name and held out for two weeks, receiving supplies by air. The Japanese, however, were poorly supplied and suffered from hunger and disease, forcing them to eventually retreat.

Les Japonais, cependant, étaient mal approvisionnés et souffrirent de la faim et de maladies, ce qui les força à finalement battre en retraite.

<English>: On February 27th 1991, the largest tank battle of the Gulf War took place in southern Iraq. American and British casualties were few, often due to friendly fire. Immediately after the battle, on February 28th, a cessation of hostilities was declared.

<English>: On April 6th 1945, the Red Army launched an assault on Königsberg, the capital of East Prussia. Königsberg had a multi-layered defense. The fortress was protected by approximately 15 large forts, concrete pillboxes, anti-tank ditches, canals and rivers, and powerful fire positions within the urban area. However, the Soviet forces were well trained and well armed, and the fortress fell on April 9th.
<French>: Le 6 avril 1945, l'Armée rouge a lancé un assaut sur Königsberg, la capitale de la Prusse-Orientale. Königsberg disposait d'une défense multicouche. La forteresse était protégée par environ 15 grands forts, des casemates en béton, des fossés antichars, des canaux et des rivières, ainsi que de puissantes positions de tir dans la zone urbaine. Cependant, les forces soviétiques étaient bien entraînées et bien armées, et la forteresse est tombée le 9 avril.

<English>: On April 9th 1940, the Wehrmacht launched an operation to seize Denmark and Norway, disguised as exercises on the Weser River. Denmark capitulated immediately, while Norway fought back, fiercely fighting for its territory for two months. This was the first major German combined naval, air, and land operation of a surprise nature. In response, Great Britain occupied Iceland and the Faroe Islands to prevent their capture by Germany.
<French>: Le 9 avril 1940, la Wehrmacht a lancé une opération pour s'emparer du Danemark et de la Norvège, déguisée en exercices sur le fleuve Weser. Le Danemark a capitulé immédiatement, tandis que la Norvège a riposté, luttant farouchement pour son territoire pendant deux mois. Ce fut la première opération allemande majeure combinant les forces navales, aériennes et terrestres de nature surprise. En réponse, la Grande-Bretagne a occupé l'Islande et les îles Féroé pour empêcher leur capture par l'Allemagne.

La Danimarca capitolò immediatamente, mentre la Norvegia oppose resistenza, combattendo strenuamente per il proprio territorio per due mesi. Questa fu la prima grande operazione tedesca combinata navale, aerea e terrestre di tipo a sorpresa. In risposta, la Gran Bretagna occupò l’Islanda e le Isole Faroe per impedirne la conquista da parte della Germania.

<English>: Shortly after the capture of Vienna, on April 15th 1945, one of the final offensive operations of the Second World War in Europe began on Austrian territory. Soviet and Bulgarian forces intended to defeat the remaining Axis forces in Austria, capture Graz, and reach the line of contact with US forces. The operation was successfully completed by May 8th-9th, but even after Germany’s surrender, the Allies had to suppress pockets of resistance from groups that refused to lay down their arms.
<French>: Peu après la prise de Vienne, le 15 avril 1945, l'une des dernières opérations offensives de la Seconde Guerre mondiale en Europe a commencé sur le territoire autrichien. Les forces soviétiques et bulgares avaient l'intention de vaincre les forces restantes de l'Axe en Autriche, de capturer Graz et d'atteindre la ligne de contact avec les forces américaines. L'opération a été menée à bien les 8 et 9 mai, mais même après la reddition de l'Allemagne, les Alliés ont dû réprimer des poches de résistance de groupes qui refusaient de déposer les armes.

L’operazione fu completata con successo entro l’8-9 maggio, ma anche dopo la resa della Germania, gli Alleati dovettero sopprimere sacche di resistenza di gruppi che si rifiutavano di deporre le armi.

<English>: In mid-April 1945, the British Army launched an offensive on Hamburg, the largest port in northern Germany. After capturing Bremen on April 26th, it quickly encircled Hamburg, and on May 3rd, the city capitulated without street fighting. On May 4th, Field Marshal Montgomery accepted the surrender of all German forces in Denmark, the Netherlands, and northwest Germany.

Le 4 mai, le maréchal Montgomery a accepté la reddition de toutes les forces allemandes au Danemark, aux Pays-Bas et dans le nord-ouest de l'Allemagne.

<English>: The next reserve line of German defense after the Gustav Line was called the Hitler Line, but when it became clear it wouldn’t hold for long, it was quickly renamed in honor of General Fridolin von Senger, who commanded the Wehrmacht forces in this sector. In late May 1944, the Allies broke through this line, pushing the Germans back to the Caesar Line. When it fell as well, the road to Rome was open.

Fin mai 1944, les Alliés franchirent la ligne, repoussant les Allemands vers la ligne César. Quand elle tombit à son tour, la route vers Rome s'ouvrit.

<English>: On June 28th 1942, the Wehrmacht launched a strategic operation in the southern USSR on two fronts: one part of Army Group South advanced on Stalingrad, the other on the Caucasus. Rostov-on-Don fell on July 24th, and on August 21st, a group of German Jägers made a demonstration march to the summit of Mount Elbrus. However, by the end of August, the advance on both fronts had stalled. Due to severely stretched communications and fuel shortages, the Wehrmacht failed to achieve its objectives and ultimately became bogged down at Stalingrad, where it ultimately lost the strategic initiative.
<French>: Le 28 juin 1942, la Wehrmacht lança une opération stratégique dans le sud de l'URSS sur deux fronts: une partie du groupe d'armées Sud avança sur Stalingrad, l'autre sur le Caucase. Rostov-sur-le-Don tomba le 24 juillet, et le 21 août, un groupe de chasseurs allemands effectua une marche de démonstration jusqu'au sommet du mont Elbrouz. Cependant, à la fin du mois d'août, l'avancée sur les deux fronts s'était enlisée. En raison de lignes de communication gravement étirées et de pénuries de carburant, la Wehrmacht échoua dans ses objectifs et finit par s'enliser à Stalingrad, où elle perdit définitivement l'initiative stratégique.
<Italian>: Il 28 giugno 1942 la Wehrmacht lanciò un’operazione strategica nell’URSS meridionale su due direttrici: una parte del Gruppo d’Armate Sud avanzò verso Stalingrado, mentre l’altra puntò al Caucaso. Rostov sul Don cadde il 24 luglio e, il 21 agosto, un gruppo di Jäger tedeschi effettuò una marcia dimostrativa fino alla vetta del Monte Elbrus. Tuttavia, entro la fine di agosto l’avanzata su entrambi i fronti si era arrestata. A causa delle linee di comunicazione eccessivamente estese e della carenza di carburante, la Wehrmacht non riuscì a raggiungere i propri obiettivi e finì per impantanarsi a Stalingrado, dove perse definitivamente l’iniziativa strategica.
